title: A/P Detail: a PDF of exactly 2,000 lines downloads, 2,001 is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure that today the organization has more than 2,001 open A/P lines.
  • Pick a set of vendors, the chosen vendors, whose open A/P lines today add up to exactly 2,000.
  • Have a vendor, vendor B, that is not one of the chosen vendors and has exactly one open A/P line today.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. In the Vendor filter, tick every one of the chosen vendors.
  2. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  3. Open the CSV and count its document rows (leave out the heading and the Totals row).
  4. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  5. In the Vendor filter, also tick vendor B.
  6. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Only the lines of the ticked vendors remain.

Step 2:

  • The CSV downloads with the "Success" message.

Step 3:

  • Exactly 2,000 document rows.

Step 4:

  • After a wait (a 2,000-row PDF can take about 30 seconds), the PDF downloads with the "Success" message: exactly 2,000 rows is allowed, and bucket rows, subtotals and the Totals row are not counted.

Step 5:

  • Vendor B's line is added, so the report now has 2,001 document rows.

Step 6:

  • "This report is too large for PDF. Export it as CSV, or narrow the filters, then try again.": exactly one message.
  • No PDF is downloaded (no new file in the browser's downloads).

The QA organization has far more than 2,000 open A/P lines, so the exact boundary is reached by ticking vendors whose lines add up to 2,000; the setup file lists them for the day of the test. If step 4 shows "We couldn't export this report. Please try again." while the CSV in step 2 worked, the test site may not have its PDF generator set up (tech plan): mark this test Blocked: "PDF generator not available on this site", not Failed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV), story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S3-R9: “The row count for the export limits is the number of customer or vendor rows (Summaries) or document rows (the other four), not counting headers, subtotals or the Totals row.”
  • S3-N1: “Over 2,000 rows, the PDF is refused before anything is generated: no download, and the message "This report is too large for PDF. Export it as CSV, or narrow the filters, then try again." Exactly 2,000 rows is allowed.”
  • S3-N3: “A refused export shows exactly one message (S3-N1 or S3-N2), never a second generic error.”
  • S3-R10: “A successful export shows the native "Success" message, "Data exported successfully." An export with no rows downloads nothing and shows the native warning "Empty export", "Export didn't yield any results".”
  • S5-R13: “The customer chip (A/R) and vendor chip (A/P) and their open menus are the native ones: Customer exactly as Sales By Customer's Customer filter (person icon), Vendor exactly as Inventory Value's Vendor filter (truck icon, "Search vendors"; as there, the search box shows only when there are more than 8 vendors). The menu has a search box, an "All customers" or "All vendors" row, the native line "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow." (or vendors) while none is ticked, and the list; several can be ticked. The chip reads "Customer: All customers" or "Vendor: All vendors" in the resting (grey) style when none is ticked, the name when one is (shortened with "..." when long), and "Customer: N customers" or "Vendor: N vendors" when N are. The ticked customers or vendors narrow every row, group, total, page, sort and export; the Location list does not change (S5-R3).”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §9 Known risks: “PDF generation: WeasyPrint HTTP (600 s client timeout) pins an FPM worker; the 2,000-row cap bounds it (~30 s).”
  • Tech plan §7 E2E backlog: “PDF generator not configured on every environment; CSV covers wiring”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 2 "Export" (board Export.dc.html); page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD and tech plan quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

  • ar-ap-p2-pdf-over-2-000-rows-is-refused.png: figure "PDF over 2,000 rows is refused" (This build (after)), board "2. Export"
  • ar-ap-p7-four-chips-on-every-report.png: figure "Four chips on every report" (This build (after)), board "7. Filters and call list"
  • ar-ap-p7-the-native-vendor-menu.png: figure "The native Vendor menu" (New in this build), board "7. Filters and call list"

The design's own words:

  • ""This report is too large for PDF. Export it as CSV, or narrow the filters, then try again." Exactly one message. CSV limit 50,000 rows. S3-N1, S3-N2, S3-N3." (caption of "PDF over 2,000 rows is refused")
  • "As of, Customer (Vendor on A/P), Past due, Location. "Customer: All customers" and "Past due: Any" rest grey, Past due with the design system’s hourglass icon. S5-R1, S5-R13, S5-R15." (caption of "Four chips on every report")
  • "Vendor chip with the truck icon, as on Inventory Value. Its menu: a search box, "All vendors" ticked, "All vendors are included. Pick one or more to narrow.", then the vendors. S5-R13, S5-R14." (caption of "The native Vendor menu")

Difference from the PRD (DD-02), closed: PRD version 5 said Vendor "exactly as Inventory Value's Vendor filter (truck icon, "Search vendors")" (S5-R13); the design shows the Vendor menu's search box reads "Search vendor" (singular); alt text: "Search vendor, All vendors and the helper line". PRD version 9 (23 Oct 2026), written after question 12, keeps "Search vendors" and adds that the search box shows only when there are more than 8 vendors (S5-R13); the singular "Search vendor" in the picture is not the requirement (Chris Ward's sheet row for question 12 repeats question 14's subject; PRD version 9 settles it). This case follows PRD version 9. The held design-version case D-77 (C715559) was deleted from TestRail on 26 Oct 2026 with the QA lead's go-ahead (snapshot in v9-pass-2026-10-26/deleted/).
